symptom: After every relay dial, a cloud worker reconfigured with the GitHub repository binding and pull-request flag removed. The relay's inbound dial advertised a feature list without github-pr-v1, while the HTTP hello advertised it. Renamed or transferred repositories could then fail PR creation with GITHUB_REMOTE_CHANGED, depending on which path delivered the last configuration.
rule: zstack-review compatibility: a capability advertised on more than one channel must come from one definition, and a test must pin what the control plane sees on each channel. Use the worker's changed-path journal line (cloud-worker reconfigure ...) to catch configurations that differ by delivery path.
check: pnpm --dir apps/cloud-worker exec vitest run src/__tests__/inbound-bridge.test.ts
